card.name: HIV and viral diagnostic test wording
card.fires_on: Small words and joiners inside sentences about testing for acute HIV-1 infection, such as 'an', 'a', 'using', '-specific' and '/' around 'antigen/antibody' tests. It also fires on a few other virus or vaccine phrases, such as 'doses of' swine flu vaccine.

modes.label: Vaccine dose counts
modes.description: The word 'of' after a quantity of vaccine doses in news text.
modes.example: the Centre has procured nearly 15 lakh doses<< of>> swine flu vaccine for distribution all over

card.writes: It slightly favors words like 'doses' and 'dose' and disfavors 'cluster' words, with no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It lights up on small joining words in text about testing for HIV infection, and occasionally in vaccine dose text.
